valor: In La Jagua, a riverside town in Huila, the men who come to open the earth for a dam disturb the territory’s pulse. Nidia, 55, a peasant and fique artisan, awaits the departure of her only son. As anxiety and insomnia set in, an unsettling presence grows within her, until she moves toward a revelation that holds the antidote to her pain.
motivo: español e inglés dicen lo mismo; catálogo de FICCI 65, p. 50

antes.ficci-65: Textual layers grow from the center to the summit of a mountain. The tensions surrounding the treasures of the earth's womb and the woman's womb trace a delicate map of stratigraphies, opaque and dark, yet of very intense life. In this experimental short, bodies pulse like an incantation against the world's pains.
